note: Width budget: a readable cog is about 20 wide (r5 hub ring + teeth to r10), so two cogs fill the 36-40 unit box; ring-head pins need an 11-unit pitch and about 18 units of clearance under each gear. What fits (8-tooth r7 gears, 3 r3 pins) reads as blobs and keyholes.
